_README: Central business configuration for the MT analytics build. Thresholds and basis choices live HERE, not inlined in formulas or JS. Loaded by scripts/build_dashboard_data.py and embedded into data.js as DASH.config, so the dashboard and Power BI read the same numbers from the same place.

target.basis_rationale: The target file (PowerBI/SeedData/Targets/FY2627_Targets.csv) is headed 'Target NSV Cr' and does not name its measure. forecast_block_ty already compares this same file to offtake, so offtake is the default. Both bases are always computed and shown side by side so the choice stays visible.
target._action: Set basis_confirmed_by/on once the business confirms whether the target is set on primary billing or on retail offtake. Until then the dashboard labels the basis as ASSUMED.

rag._note: Green/amber boundaries. A value at or above 'green' is green; at or above 'amber' is amber; below is red. For run_rate_ratio LOWER is better, so the comparison inverts.

readiness._note: Data readiness gates. An analytical layer must not present output as authoritative until its preconditions hold. Each gate names the precondition, the threshold and what unblocks it. Evaluated by readiness_gate() at build time and published as DASH.readiness; the dashboard shows a blocked layer's reason instead of a confident-looking number.

chain_primary.label: Chain-level Primary reporting
chain_primary.requires: mapping_completeness_pct >= 85 on the current FY primary
chain_primary.unblocks_with: Owner-approved distributor-to-chain mapping for the ship-to parties listed in the unmapped exception report.

pvm.label: Price-Volume-Mix
pvm.requires: Article-level Qty and NSV present on the detail records, with a usable blended ASP
pvm.unblocks_with: Article-level Qty on detail_records. Does NOT use unit_economics.nsv_per_unit, which is degenerate (0.02 for every zone and month) and has no generator in this repo.

profitability.label: Profitability / margin analytics
profitability.requires: Cost or margin fields present at the reporting grain
profitability.unblocks_with: A COGS or standard-cost field per article. Not present today, so margin is NOT computed; CM2 and P&L remain as-is on their own documented basis.

scorecard_execution.label: OSA / OOS / fill-rate columns on the scorecard
scorecard_execution.requires: Store-audit coverage across the reporting universe in the reporting period
scorecard_execution.unblocks_with: A store audit covering the reporting months. compliance_metrics.json today audits 189 doors of a 426-store universe (44%) and is labelled Q3 FY27 while the reporting window is Apr-Jul'26.

npd.label: NPD tracker
npd.requires: NPD launch and article master joined to the transaction grain
npd.unblocks_with: A join key between PowerBI/SeedData/NPI_Master.csv article ids and the EAN/Article values on detail_records.

sales_consolidation.label: Consolidated sales actuals (incentive scope)
sales_consolidation.requires: DMS months matching the incentive period, and a dedup rule proving no double counting
sales_consolidation.unblocks_with: DMS for every month in the incentive period. Applies to the incentive working only — the commercial reports use chain sales and are unaffected.

incentive.label: Incentive calculation
incentive.requires: Slab master, employee master, incentive grade per employee, role-scope targets, actuals at role grain, and every business rule confirmed
incentive.unblocks_with: Incentive grade (Asst/regular/Sr) for the 14 RKAM/NKAM/BA Lead employees; zone/account/territory targets; target basis (Primary vs Offtake); confirmation of conflicts C1-C6, the payout caps, and the nested lower-is-better slab rule.

persona_reporting.label: Persona reporting (Leadership / Account / NKAM / RKAM / BDE)
persona_reporting.requires: Store->employee hierarchy resolved on a stable key
persona_reporting.unblocks_with: Employee IDs on the WoA hierarchy (it carries first names only), and Store-SO mapping for Jun'26 and Jul'26.

run_rate._note: Monthly run rate. Business planning here is monthly, and the source grain is monthly, so a daily rate would imply precision the data does not carry.

mom._note: Metrics the MoM view shows when present. Anything unavailable is listed with its reason rather than shown as zero.

brands._note: Emerging-brand classification. CONFIRMED BY THE BUSINESS (MT Channel Analyst Lead) on 2026-09-11: every MT brand EXCEPT Mamaearth is an emerging brand. Stated as a rule, not a hardcoded list, so a new brand is emerging by default the moment it appears in the data -- which is the intent.

zones._note: Canonical zone names. Four source systems spell the same zone four ways (dashboard 'South 1', employee master 'South-1', WoA 'South_1', Massit 'SOUTH-1'). Normalisation is by RULE (casefold, strip, collapse -/_/space) rather than an ever-growing alias list, with explicit overrides only where a rule cannot reach. Raw values are always preserved alongside the canonical one.
zones.normalize_rule: casefold -> strip -> replace [-_] with space -> collapse whitespace -> title-case -> match against canonical
zones._ho_note: HO is an employee location, not a sales zone. Held out of zone sales reporting rather than silently dropped.

sales_actuals._note: Source priority for Actual Sales. Chain sales is authoritative; Massit/DMS is a GAP-FILL source only, never additive. Measured evidence (Jun-26): 98.8% of Massit tertiary belongs to chains already covered by chain sales, so adding the two would overstate sales by ~Rs 35.6 Cr in one month. Massit's real value here is store-level grain and employee attribution, which chain sales does not carry.
sales_actuals._massit_measure_note: Tertiary = sell-out to consumer, the same basis as chain offtake. Secondary (distributor->store) is a different measure and must NOT be mixed in -- see CLAUDE.md 'The three MT measures'.
sales_actuals.dedup_rule: A Massit client whose chain already has chain-sales coverage in the period is DUPLICATE and is excluded from the consolidated actual. Only a client whose chain has no chain-sales coverage is gap-fill.
sales_actuals._missing_note: Absent sales stays blank and is labelled NO_SALES_DATA. It is never converted to zero -- a zero reads as 'sold nothing', which is a different business statement from 'we have no data'.
sales_actuals._scope: INCENTIVE ONLY. Business instruction 2026-09-11: DMS/Massit is used for the incentive working and must NOT appear in or influence the commercial reports (Executive Cockpit, MoM, scorecards, PVM, Target vs Achievement). Those stay on chain sales. DMS output is written to incentive_working/, never to dashboard/data.js.

focus_pack._note: Focus Pack EAN classification comes from the supplied chain x article x month file (F1/F2 tags). Massit's own 'Focus Tag' column is blank on every row and must NOT be used as evidence either way.
